empty.title: No cards registered yet
empty.lead: Click <0>Register card</0> to add one manually, or <1>Import (Excel / CSV)</1> to bulk-import.

import.title: Import cards (Excel or CSV)
import.dropPrompt: Drop the Excel or CSV file here or click to browse
import.upsertNote: Imported cards are added to the ones already registered: no need to re-import the whole list, the file can contain only the new cards. A card whose chip ID already exists is updated.
import.howToFill: How do I fill in the file?

guide.title: Filling in the cards import file
guide.intro: Download the Excel template, add one row per card following the guidance below, then import the file with the "Import" button.
guide.previewNote: Row 1: headers (do not change). Row 2: example card, to replace with your cards.

key_name.description: Card name, shown in games and rankings (e.g. a letter, a word, a first name).

color.description: Color of the card or its holder, free text. Can be left empty.

key_number.description: Number of the card in your set (the one you write on its label). Whole number; two cards can't share the same number.

id.description: Serial number printed on the SportIdent chip. Whole number, unique, no spaces or separators.

template.noteHeaders: Fill in the "Cards" sheet without changing the first row (headers): one card per row.
template.noteExample: Row 2 is an example card: replace or delete it. If it stays in the file, it is ignored on import.
template.noteAddOnly: To add cards, list only the new ones: cards already registered are kept.
template.noteUpdate: If a chip ID already exists, that card's details are updated.

confirmDelete.title: Delete card?
confirmDelete.warning: This deletes the card on studio and on every device on the next sync. It cannot be undone.

toast.keyNumberTaken: This key number is already taken by another card
toast.keyNumberInUse: Key number already in use - choose another
toast.chipIdRegistered: A card with this chip ID is already registered
toast.chipIdPositive: Chip ID must be a positive integer
toast.keyNumberPositive: Key number must be a positive integer
toast.onlyCsv: Only Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV files are allowed
